<div class="card-body">
'''Lirin Car'n''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊ライリン・カーン</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">他の音楽家と同じ位置カード上にいるなら、ライリンは“用心棒代”を徴収することができる。そこにいる本人以外の音楽家一人につき、キャラクターをその位置に配備したり、移動させるコストに1を加える。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Lirin-Carn-PSA-160005372.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ビス男性の傭兵。フィグリン・ダンのバンドの控えのクルー・ホーンのプレイヤーでもある。ドイック以外で唯一、楽器の所有権をフィグリンに奪われていないミュージシャンである。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Lirin Car'n.

'''Card text:'''
If at the same location card as other musicians, Lirin may collect a “bodyguard fee.” For each musician there other than himself, add 1 to the cost for a character to deploy to or move to that location.

'''Lore:'''
A male Bith mercenary. He is also the backup Kloo Horn player in Figrin D'an's band. Besides Doikk, he is the only musician who has not lost ownership of his instrument to Figrin.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese cover charge is 用心棒代.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Lirin Car'n]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
